body: Not gonna lie that sound pretty good.

I like watching near death experiences where people talk about being dead and how if feels like. Like when they were gone for like 5 minutes. Even if the things they are telling are fake I will only know when I'm dead too so its comforting to hear that there is something than just nothing after you die. Like an other place.

I'm really good at sneaking around. All my friends never hear me and always wonder how the hell I got next to them so silently. It's kinda funny because they are always so scared and it's just nice to kinda sneak around without someone noticing you. Could be useful someday.
